name: VIP Galaxy Villas
shortDescription: Villas in Rawai by VIP Property Development, about 0.9 km from Rawai Beach.
description:
VIP Galaxy Villas is a villa development in Rawai on Phuket's south coast by VIP Property Development Co., Ltd. (VIP Thailand Group), which also builds VIP Tropika and other Phuket projects. Agent listings put Rawai Beach about 0.9 km away.

Listings show 3 bedroom villas of roughly 290 to 340 sqm built-up. Agents report different unit counts and a completion around December 2026, so confirm both with us; some listings mix this project with VIP Galaxy Rawai Villas.

Starting prices are about 22.3 million baht in agent listings. A rental programme mentioned by one portal is not a guarantee and is not offered by us. Message us on WhatsApp for the price list.
